nodes.label: SEAD Authority Service
nodes.rationale: Reconciliation and identity service with two primary functions: matching fuzzy text queries to canonical SEAD entity identifiers (OpenRefine Reconciliation API) and managing stable UUIDs for incoming SEAD data submissions (SIMS).

nodes.label: FastAPI Application
nodes.rationale: Single FastAPI process on port 8000 with no frontend layer; all interaction via REST API. Stateless across requests except for the connection pool singleton.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Router
nodes.rationale: OpenRefine-compatible endpoints (POST /reconcile, GET /suggest/*, GET /flyout/entity, GET /reconcile/preview). Parses form-encoded or JSON query format and delegates to the reconciliation orchestrator. No business logic.

nodes.label: Identity Router
nodes.rationale: SIMS endpoints under /identity for identity resolution, binding set management, change detection, and scope listing. No business logic; validation via Pydantic models.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Coordinates batched reconciliation requests: extracts entity type, looks up registered strategy, retrieves candidates, scores them, and formats results in OpenRefine response structure. Batch queries processed sequentially (known limitation).

nodes.label: Strategy Registry
nodes.rationale: Central extensibility mechanism. Strategies auto-register at import time via @Strategies.register(key=..., repository_cls=...). Populated when main.py imports src.strategies, triggering recursive module loading.

nodes.label: ReconciliationStrategy
nodes.rationale: Abstract base class providing default find/score/format behaviour. Subclasses override only what differs for entity-specific matching logic, property parsing, alternate identity matching, and scoring.

nodes.label: RAGHybridReconciliationStrategy
nodes.rationale: Fuzzy retrieval → optional MCP retrieval → LLM validation. Inherits from ReconciliationStrategy. Only invoked when a strategy opts into the RAG hybrid path.

nodes.label: BaseRepository
nodes.rationale: Abstracts PostgreSQL queries from strategy logic. Implements trigram-based fuzzy search, alternate-identity exact matching, and single-entity detail retrieval against generated authority.* views. Uses get_connection() and parameterized SQL.

nodes.label: SiteRepository
nodes.rationale: Specialized subclass of BaseRepository adding entity-specific queries such as geographic proximity search for sites.

nodes.label: ConfigValue
nodes.rationale: Lazy resolver supporting colon-separated paths (options:database:host) and comma-separated fallback paths (llm.ollama.model,llm.model). All config lookups use ConfigValue. Enables mocking in tests without patching env.

nodes.label: get_connection()
nodes.rationale: Singleton connection pool created once at startup in setup.py and stored in runtime config. All repositories use this. Never instantiate connections directly.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.rationale: Provider abstraction over OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama. Active provider selected by llm.provider in config. Prompt templates in config/prompts.yml rendered with Jinja2. LLM calls are async and only invoked when a strategy opts into the RAG hybrid path.

nodes.label: IdentityService
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates the full resolution and binding lifecycle for SEAD Identity Management System (SIMS). Manages stable UUID allocation and binding lifecycle for incoming SEAD data submissions.

nodes.label: IdentityPolicy
nodes.rationale: Loads config/identity_policy.yml and drives resolve/allocate/auto-confirm behaviour per entity type.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL (SEAD Database)
nodes.rationale: External SEAD PostgreSQL database. Service reads entity data via generated authority.* views and writes identity/binding records to six identity tables. Requires pg_trgm; optionally pgvector and PostGIS.

nodes.label: LLM Providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama)
nodes.rationale: External LLM providers for candidate validation and ranking. Ollama or LLM API key required for RAG strategies; strategies using LLM validation fail at runtime without a configured provider.

nodes.label: Embedded MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Embedded MCP server providing hybrid retrieval for RAG strategies via stdio. Shares the FastAPI process; cannot scale independently. Provides search_lookup tool.

nodes.label: OpenRefine
nodes.rationale: External client submitting reconciliation queries via HTTP (POST /reconcile). Inbound integration.

nodes.label: Shape Shifter
nodes.rationale: External submission tool sending identity resolution requests via HTTP (POST /identity/resolve). Out of scope for this service but integrates with it.

nodes.label: config.yml
nodes.rationale: Base configuration file. Includes entities.yml and prompts.yml via @include directives. Read-only at runtime. Environment variables substituted from .env at startup.

nodes.label: entities.yml
nodes.rationale: Entity schema definitions; source of truth for entity view generation. Included via @include in config.yml. Run make generate-schema after editing.

nodes.label: prompts.yml
nodes.rationale: LLM prompt templates rendered with Jinja2 before submission. Included via @include in config.yml.

nodes.label: identity_policy.yml
nodes.rationale: SIMS per-entity policy configuration. Read by IdentityPolicy to drive resolve/allocate/auto-confirm behaviour.

nodes.label: Schema Generation
nodes.rationale: Entity database views, indexes, and search functions generated from config/entities.yml using Jinja2 templates in schema/templates/. Run make generate-schema after editing entity config. Never edit schema/generated/ directly.

nodes.label: Authority Views (authority.*)
nodes.rationale: Generated SQL views (authority.view_site, etc.), trigram indexes, and optional embedding tables (authority.method_embeddings). Logically separate from SEAD public schema.

nodes.label: Identity Tables
nodes.rationale: Six tables: identity_scopes, identity_submissions, source_identities, tracked_identities, binding_sets, bindings. Managed exclusively by the identity service; no other component writes to them.

nodes.label: pg_trgm
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL extension required for fuzzy search. Without it, corresponding strategy features are unavailable.

nodes.label: pgvector
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL extension for semantic search (optional). Required for RAG hybrid strategies that use vector-based retrieval.

nodes.label: SiteReconciliationStrategy
nodes.rationale: Entity-specific strategy for sites with coordinate parsing and geographic proximity search via SiteRepository.

nodes.label: TaxonReconciliationStrategy
nodes.rationale: Entity-specific strategy for taxon matching with entity-specific overrides from base ReconciliationStrategy.

nodes.label: MethodReconciliationStrategy
nodes.rationale: Entity-specific strategy for method matching. One of the entity strategies registered in the strategy registry.
